13705.desc: Awesome Daimyo Hermitaur claw. Only veterans get it; only true smiths can use it.

13706.desc: Vivid orange Hypnocatrice hair. Fluffy, nice to touch, and liked by all.

13707.desc: Hypnocatrice claw strong enough to smash bedrock. None survive it unharmed.

13708.desc: Saliva from a Hypnocatrice's special gland. It is sticky and forms soap bubbles.

13709.desc: Fine Hypnocatrice crest. With the rarity of the individual, hard to obtain.

13710.desc: Eerily glowing Hypnocatrice bezoar. Superstition: stare at it and have nightmares.

13711.desc: Vocal organ of a Hypnocatrice with an odd beak. It haunts sleepers.

13712.desc: Feather on a Hypnocatrice tail. Top in fur and quality: a dream material.

13713.desc: Hypnocatrice tail feather. Coated in dust released when angry. Fine quality.

13714.desc: Abnormally huge Hypnocatrice beak. Long survival struggle led to aggressive evolution.

13715.desc: Hypnocatrice beak tough enough to crush bedrock. It can blast sleep gas too.

13716.desc: Beak of a Hypnocatrice that brings drowsiness. One look and you fall asleep.

13717.desc: Beak of an overwhelmingly strong Hypnocatrice. Every craftsman dreams of it.

13718.desc: Espinas scale of superb strength and beauty. Not a single flaw to be seen.

13719.desc: Sharp red Espinas spine. A light touch strips flesh and poisons you.

13720.desc: Espinas shell of superb strength and beauty. Doesn't seem poisonous.

13721.desc: Deadly-poisonous Espinas blood. So toxic that normal antidotes are no use.

13722.desc: Organ that stores Espinas's deadly venom. It is too toxic to have been studied.

13723.desc: Large, beautiful jewel made in an Espinas. Its crimson recalls rage.

13724.desc: Sharp red Espinas claw. Poison runs inside, so touching it gives pause.

13725.desc: Fine Espinas wing. Veins in the membrane turn bright red when it threatens.

13726.desc: Organ that makes venom. Oddly, it becomes harmless once carved.

13727.desc: Nematocysts over Espinas's claws, horns, skin. All linked to poison glands.

13728.desc: Espinas marrow with deadly poison. All poison passes here to circulate.

13729.desc: Poisonous Espinas tail. Less toxic than the horn, so relatively safe to handle.

13730.desc: Horn of an Espinas that mutated abnormally. The cause is unknown.

13731.desc: Espinas horn mutated abnormally. Thousands of poison glands had gathered.

13732.desc: Horn of a wildly mutated Espinas. Inside you can see a giant poison duct.

13733.desc: Espinas horn mutated abnormally. Powerful poison even changed its shape.

13734.desc: Khezu hide so plump you can't let go once you hold it.

13735.desc: Blue blood circulating in Khezu. Creepy, but it smells a little nice.

13736.desc: White membrane under Khezu's skin layer. Tissue suited to controlling electricity.

13737.desc: Faint hair all over a Khezu. It feels prey vibrations with its whole body.

13738.desc: Khezu hide with a jewel-like gleam. Strong discharge seems to change the skin.

13739.desc: Pearl-like ball formed in a Khezu. It is a little squishy, though.

13740.desc: Soft but splendid Khezu wing. It bears the marks of many wounds, healed over.

13741.desc: Soft but splendid Khezu wing. Its many scars let you feel its strength.

13742.desc: A Khezu stomach never examined before. Very disgusting.

13743.desc: One of the largest Khezu stomachs. Fuller than an ordinary stomach.

13744.desc: Khezu sucker evolved for clinging to cave ceilings. Softer than expected.

13745.desc: Khezu sucker with stronger adhesion than normal. It's still soft and pleasant.

13746.desc: Head of a Khezu mutated beyond recognition. An important research material.

13747.desc: Head of a Khezu mutated beyond recognition. It seizes prey for sure.

13748.desc: Head of a Khezu mutated beyond recognition. Its voltage is beyond compare.

13749.desc: Head of a Khezu mutated beyond recognition. Electricity caused it.

13750.desc: Scale of an especially deep color. Dark swallows light: no reflection at all.

13751.desc: Jet-black armor wrapping Gore Magala. Blows are swallowed by darkness first.

13752.desc: Death-bringing curved claw. Those infected via the third arm suffer for ages.

13753.desc: Ominous wing flickering through nights. It drives those it takes to madness.

13754.desc: Pearl of darkness that swallows all light. Pure black seals light within.

13755.desc: Gore Magala reverse scale on its wing-arm. Life-eating Frenzy tints it purple.

13756.desc: Black tail of bristling scales. It cuts like a whip by flexing, not sweeping.

13757.desc: Honed Gore Magala antenna. Horn-shaped, it leaks gloomy purple Frenzy light.

13758.desc: Eroded scales with strong Frenzy remnants. Gear of them becomes cursed armor.

13759.desc: Fine Gore Magala scale. Many are charmed by its matte jet-black color.

13760.desc: Heavy, dark Gore Magala shell. Users of its gear aren't guaranteed sanity.

13761.desc: Warped claw of Gore Magala that spins madness. Smiths fear disease and hesitate.

13762.desc: Calamity's dark wings that melt into night. Spreading dark plague, like a reaper.

13763.desc: Phantom black scale of Gore Magala. As gear, it is said to grant superhuman power.

13764.desc: Sharp black tail with bristling scales. One swing shreds you with them.

13765.desc: Large antenna blinking purple. Its light is an ill omen; keeping it was taboo.

13766.desc: Heat-soaked Rathalos shell. Often scorching just after a kill, so it's hard to carve.

13767.desc: Rathalos scale evolved uniquely. A proof of valor.

13768.desc: Rathalos claw that tears anything apart. Its cuts leave brand-like marks.

13769.desc: Very rare Rathalos marrow. Holds a hot flame.

13770.desc: Rathalos scale glowing from intense heat. Normally can't even be touched.

13771.desc: Dazzling Rathalos gem. Hard to even see; crafting it needs special skill.

13772.desc: Spine on a Rathalos head. Sharp and pointed: be careful.

13773.desc: A particularly fine spine on a Rathalos's head. Its valor seeps out.

13774.desc: Material carved from a special Rathalos tail. High quality, so in high demand.

13775.desc: Rathalos tail that blazes when angry. Swung, it sets the ground aflame.

13776.desc: Rathalos wing grown big for long flights. A symbol of the sky's ruler.

13777.desc: Blazing wing of Rathalos, King of the Skies. Having it is like ruling the skies.

13778.desc: Magnificent Rathalos wing. Flame-wrapped, soaring: it is truly King of the Skies.

13779.desc: Terrifying Rathalos wing. Its flames turn any land to scorched earth.

13780.desc: A moist-feeling cloth said to give the wearer a vivid beauty.

13781.desc: Sharply torn scale. The Workshop might make something of it.

13783.desc: Paper with the recipe for Mavrov. Take it to the Workshop!

13784.desc: Paper with the recipe for Rozovi. Take it to the Workshop!

13785.desc: Paper with the recipe for Viguru. Take it to the Workshop!

13786.desc: Paper with the recipe for Solitaire. Take it to the Workshop!

13787.desc: Paper with the recipe for Puretto. Take it to the Workshop!

13788.desc: Paper with the recipe for Nekyuro. Take it to the Workshop!

13789.desc: A memento for hunters who first came to the new land.

13790.desc: Paper with the recipe for Sakufi Series. Take it to the Workshop!

13797.desc: Paper on how to unlock Harokyu D Series. Take it to the Workshop!

13798.desc: Paper on how to unlock Higakure C Series. Take it to the Workshop!
